steps.title: What this does
steps.confirm: I understand that agents I allow can fully control the computers I add.
steps.body:
Agents you allow can see other computers over your private network (Tailscale), and control them when you allow it.

There are three levels:

- **Look:** see the screen and facts.
- **Act:** run commands as administrator.
- **Drive:** use the mouse and keyboard.

Your phone is asked before an agent's first Act or Drive in each session.

Use a computer with nothing personal on it.

An agent you allow to Act or Drive can do anything on it.

steps.title: Set it up

adminChoice.label: Run it without an administrator
adminChoice.warning: The server then has the same access to files as your Maestro.

steps.body: Installs the remote-control server on the computer your Maestro runs on, finds this computer on your private network, and starts the server. It downloads about 210 MB once.

steps.title: Add a computer
steps.body:
Windows computers for now.

On the computer you want to control:

1. Sign in to Tailscale on it with the same account.
2. Open the link below in a browser there within 15 minutes.
3. Run the downloaded file and choose **Install**.
4. This page shows it when it connects.

For agents to see the screen:

- Use a local account that signs in by itself.
- Set it to never lock or sleep.
- Keep personal files and accounts off it.

steps.title: Wait for the computer
steps.body: This page checks that the computer has connected. It can take a minute.

steps.title: Who may use it
steps.body:
Choose which agents may use remote computers, and what each may do. The lead agent is always allowed.

- **Look:** see the screen and facts.
- **Act:** also run commands.
- **Drive:** also use the mouse and keyboard.

Every agent starts at Look. For Act and Drive, **Ask me before each session** is ticked, so you say yes on your phone. Turn it off only for an agent you fully trust.
